result:
Fixed. Root cause: `Command.main()` handled `KeyboardInterrupt` and reported errors from inside `except` blocks (`echo`/`e.show()`/`sys.exit()`), which sit outside the `try` that catches `KeyboardInterrupt` â€” a second Ctrl-C during that reporting step escaped as an unhandled traceback instead of exiting cleanly (upstream click issue #3802).

Applied the upstream fix (PR #3818): handlers now only collect a `report` callback and `exit_code`, with the actual message-printing and `sys.exit()` moved to one place at the end of an outer `try`/`except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt)` â€” so a late interrupt can only cost the "Aborted!" message, never the correct exit code or cause a raw traceback. Updated `CHANGES.md` and `docs/exceptions.md` to match, and added `tests/test_abort_interrupt.py` covering interrupts during abort/error reporting and during the final exit. Full test suite (1931 tests) passes.
